'''Comran''' was a crewman aboard the [[Haj Shipping Lines]] [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Star of Empire]]'' who was killed when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]] known as [[Systems Infiltration Manager]] took control of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] [[0 ABY/Legends|eleven months after]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==Biography==
The [[Gender/Legends|male]] called Comran served aboard the [[Haj Shipping Lines]] [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Star of Empire]]'' during [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. Eleven months after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]] known as [[Systems Infiltration Manager]] took control of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], setting off an alarm indicating the imminent meltdown of the [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]] which caused the passengers and most of the crew to evacuate. Comran was one of the few who volunteered to stay aboard with the ship's commanding officer, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hajj]], in order attempt to shut down the engines.

When it became clear that the meltdown was a false alarm, Hajj's team set off for the communications room to send a distress signal. Along the way they encountered several violent [[Droid/Legends|droids]], including one group who were attacking three remaining passengers, [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] and the brother and sister, [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak]] and [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]]. Comran helped to destroy the droids and both groups joined up in their efforts to reach the communications room. The group split into two [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]] to make the journey up to the communications room, but SIM had control of the turbolifts and caused them both to drop uncontrolled. Comran, sharing a turbolift with Hajj, Rendar, the Arrandas and one other crewman, was saved when Rendar was able to halt the turbolift's descent; however, the four crewmen in the other turbolift were [[Death/Legends|killed]].

The survivors attempted to continue their ascent through a nearby gangway, but a droid under SIM's control dropped a [[Landspeeder/Legends|hovercar]] engine down the shaft at them. Comran was struck by the falling engine and fell to his death.
